title: An earlier answer
text: Bees use visual cues to point hive mates toward nectar sources.

title: Honeybee communication
text: Honeybees perform a waggle dance to communicate the direction and distance of food sources to hive mates. The dance angle signals direction and its duration signals distance.

title: Bat echolocation
text: Bats locate insects by emitting ultrasonic calls and listening for returning echoes.
